create_T1Env: create a T1Env instance with an xml path and config for a MuJoCo T1 locomotion environment
get_T1_assets: get model assets for T1 environments by loading XML files from the T1 and Menagerie paths
get_gravity_sensor: get the gravity vector in the world frame from MuJoCo simulation data
get_robot_velocity: get global and local linear velocity and angular velocity of the robot from simulation data
get_sensor_readings: get accelerometer and gyroscope readings in the local frame from MuJoCo simulation data
